name: Treg
description: Give your agent one connection to thousands of tools and your team's own APIs. It can search by task, check prices, and call tools while Treg handles the provider keys.

prompts.text: Find a tool for monthly keyword search volume. What does one lookup cost?
Which tools has my team connected to Treg?
Use Treg to find the latest OpenBot release and link to its release notes.

apps.name: Treg
apps.description: Choose a Treg team to use its connected tools and the Treg catalog. Paid calls use that team's credits.
